verdict.rationale: Stable documents its own keyword-based auto-routing that reads mail contents and envelopes, AI sorting, tags, and tailored Slack/email alerts. Its registered agent product gives instant digital access to state and legal mail, including service of process, with automated routing to act on it quickly. These could surface IRS, state, and legal mail, but nothing shows built-in classification or prioritization of government/legal mail or any deadline tracking. missing for 10: explicit automatic detection/flagging of government and legal mail, priority or urgency marking, compliance-deadline extraction or reminders, independent/hands-on corroboration.
